notes.title: NEW PATCH 1.6.7 AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Endera Agents,[/b]
We hear all complains about minor bugs which you've experienced in the last 2 weeks loud & clear. We have been really busy before GAMESCOM 2016, but we wanted to get new patch to you as soon as possible.

We hope you all will enjoy our improvements. The list with the changes you can read below.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/79bcac9b9e17be7c24794a35ae7a7b09d5126051.png[/img]

[h1]1.6.7 CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Resolved issue with "outside buffer" error
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug which cause crash of the game during Save Jetsen mission
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug which cause crash of the game during talking with Selassie about his lost herb
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug which cause crash of the game inside the main menu - when you want to mute some characters
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue preventing players to continue after level 12 with selected Russian language
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]Issue causing letterbox when is the screenshot saved under smaller resolutions than 1920x1080.
    [*]On OS X is not able to use gamepads for "unknown" reason.
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hearing how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released a troubleshoot article to help you solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio :auriel:

notes.title: NEW PATCH 1.6.6 AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Endera Agents,[/b] 
 We are working hard to finally fix all previously reported issues. Yes, we have skipped 2 versions. So, by now you can play the newest stable version 1.6.6 on Windows, Linux and Mac! This new patch is not so big as the previous ones. It's a smaller one, but that only means we are close to the finish line.

We hope you will enjoy our improvements, though!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/64cb6b6943e0e66d33e8503bc2ccc39b5fe8c99f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1.6.4 CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]New name for executable file on Windows changed from BLACKHOLE.exe to BH.exe due to bad recognition by Anti-Virus software (Be aware: BLACKHOLE is well known virus shared by email - not Steam. [b]Our game is not a virus[/b] - so we changed the name of the file just for player's sure)
    [*]Improved stability of Mac OS X version
    [*]Challenge Vault stability improvements
    [*]New Challenge Vault music
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](FIX) Game sometimes crashes before it actually starts (driver issues)
    [*](FIX) Fixed procedure which saves levels
    [*](FIX) Fixed information about controllers during first game launch
    [*](FIX) Fixed sound of falling during cutscene in Crashsite to No-Man's Land
    [*](FIX) Fixed controller re-mapping issues and crashes
    [*](FIX) Fixed stuttering on Fullscreen when you play on NVIDIA GTX980Ti and GTX1080
    [*](FIX) Hopefully fixed Intel HD Graphics and Intel Iris texture memory leak on Mac OS X
    [*](FIX) Fixed minor bug in the main menu
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]Issue causing letterbox when is the screenshot saved under smaller resolutions than 1920x1080.
    [*]Issue which disable gamepad controller for OS X version.
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hearing how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released a troubleshoot article to help you solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio :auriel:

notes.title: BLACKHOLE PATCH 1.6.2 OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that today all players have got an instant access to our newest patch. The Challenge Vault is our answer to multiplayer in Blackhole. It works as asynchronous tournament mode. For the next 15 weeks you will find brand new levels crafted specifically for speedruns challenges.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/1d6c3a60b07d266670c3e55eec8269d1dafaf9f2.png[/img]

[i][b]If you have the best time, you can become the King of the Vault! And that's something, since you can also win a very special price.[/b][/i]

[h1]1.6.2 CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed more than 300+ bugs across the game
    [*]New game mode: Challenge Vault
    [*]Online leaderboards
    [*]New ingame menu for lost Dog Tags
    [*]New Director's Cut levels for owners of Complete Edition
    [*]New bonus content for Complete Edition owners
    [*]Brand new locations in the game to explore (2 for each entity!)
    [*]Improved overall FPS rate in the Sacred Library
    [*]Replaced some graphical resources to newer iterations
    [*]Fixed missing overlay on OS X version.
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](FIX) Fixed several camera issues during cutscenes
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue on Mac causing crashing the game after 10 minutes of gameplay
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue in Challenge Vault Replay system after which game crashed
    [*](FIX) Fixed missing dog-tags by recovering map files
    [*](FIX) Fixed two minor memory leaks
    [*](NEW) Added ability to hide hint keys during the replay
    [*](FIX) Fixed several GUI problems and text overlapping
    [*](FIX) Fixed missing translations (all languages)
    [*](FIX) Fixed stability of the server for Challenge Vault
    [*](FIX) Overall improvement in texture pages causing less crashes on integrated graphics cards
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue where you get disconnected while exiting the level which is not included in Challenge Vault Leaderboards
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue when wind dissapear from the level in Crazy Avalanche on Mac
    [*](FIX) Fixed several camera issues during cutscenes
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue causing “BLACKHOLE stop responding” when exiting the game
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]Issue causing letterbox when is the screenshot saved under smaller resolutions than 1920x1080.
    [*]Issue which disable gamepad controller for OS X version.
    [*]Issue when you change windows to fullscreen or vice-versa, causing memory leak on OS X and Linux.
    [*]Issue when some sounds are missing after a while of playing on OS X and Linux.
    [*]Issue where game unexpectedly crashes without any error on OS X. 
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hearing how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released a troubleshoot article to help you solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio :auriel:

notes.title: The biggest update is here – 1.0.5C OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Several months past after we have made the biggest preparations for console launch of the game. And since it’s coming for Xbox One and PlayStation 4 some additional features, we implemented the same features into our Windows and Linux version as well.

[i][b]We want to apologize to all Mac version players. This following update is not compatible with Mac OS X yet. But we are working hard to finish update also for OS X version as soon as possible. Thank you for understanding.[/b][/i]

[img]http://www.blackhole-game.com/uploads/bh_language_update.png[/img]

We have hopefully resolved the biggest issues with controllers, several layout issues in GUI, we updated our FONT to newest version which currently supports also Cyrillic charset – making the game available also in all-native Russian language!

On top of that, we have fixed more than 300 bugs/glitches, made big optimization of both: the code and the engine. This update signed under 1.0.5C is also nicknamed as CONSOLE READY. And we are proud to announce the game is coming to Xbox One and PlayStation 4 really soon this year! :)

Right now, we have last big step ahead in our Blackhole journey. Release of completely new FREE DLC called “Challenge Vault”. Challenge Vault will uncover each week for several times new levels – each week you can run through the level and be the BEST from the best and stand on the top.

Challenge Vault is feature available only for STEAM version of the game, and it will be great thing for everyone seeking the "multiplayer" element in our game. :)

[h1]1.0.5C CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed more than 300+ bugs across the game
    [*]Added new language: Russian
    [*]Revamped Endera graphics
    [*]Newly scripted intro section
    [*]Steam Controller Support
    [*]New loading system (slower, but efficient for laptop users)
    [*]New controllers finder procedure
    [*]Brand new locations in the game to explore (2 for each entity!)
    [*]Improved overall FPS rate in the Sacred Library
    [*]Replaced some sounds to higher quality ones
    [*]Fixed graphical issues for most of the integrated graphics cards
    [*]Fixed textures fallout on Intel HD Graphics
    [*]New texture streaming causing overall less RAM usage
    [*]Improvement movement for the character
    [*]Added Rage Quit Shortcut [ALT+F4]
    [*]Fixed problem with newest DirectX library causing Blackhole won't start
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](NEW) Added MASTER VOLUME option 
    [*](FIX) Fixed several camera issues during cutscenes
    [*](FIX) Fixed glitched map on Linux
    [*](FIX) Sacred Library – Elevator – jump through walls
    [*](FIX) Starting spectator mode hides the result screen
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue when Ati leaving Sacred Library, he got stuck into doors – jumping
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue when Selassie is trying to run to you – glitches
    [*](FIX) Fixed both endings – bad language file in English mode
    [*](FIX) Fixed graphics glitches causing lines around object on smaller resolutions of the game
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue, when WIND were disabling some sounds unintentionally
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue with neverending Quest from Selassie after finishing the game
    [*](FIX) Fixed several dialogues errors (dialogues which had never chance to play)
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Crazy avalanche run is 3x slower
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Lava run is 3x slower 
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Blocks in desert entity are disintegrate 3x more slowly 
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Rescuing the crew members are easier than in original mode
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Finding all missing parts are easier than ever 
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]Issue causing letterbox when is the screenshot saved under smaller resolutions than 1920x1080.
    [*](Windows Only) Issue causing “BLACKHOLE stop responding” when exiting the game
    [*](Mac OS X Only) Missing Steam Overlay
[/list]

[h1]What next?[/h1]
We are now working on Challenge Vault DLC. In the meantime, don't miss the opportunity to get some additional content for the game:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/322700
http://store.steampowered.com/app/323650

We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hear how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released troubleshoot article to solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio ːaurielː

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 now available and more information about upcoming news!
notes.notes:
Dear players, 
 we want to thank you for your amazing patience with us. We hope you are all enjoying BLACKHOLE. The following are brief upcoming news. It's been a month since the BLACKHOLE release and we've been trying to collect all your feedback. Please, continue to send us your awesome thoughts and ideas.

For a better gameplay experience, we made these changes in this very critical update:

[h1]1.0.4 CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Improved engine processing by 400% (less FPS drops)
    [*]Configurable key bindings option
    [*]Fixed STEAM CLOUD functionality
    [*]Featured Spanish language pack
    [*]Player's profiles are more visible now
[/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](INF) Windows XP is no longer supported
    [*](NEW) You can turn off controller's vibrations now
    [*](NEW) Particles & GPU optimalization
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing sticking in the Sacred Library elevator
    [*](FIX) Fixed minor graphics glitches
    [*](FIX) Fixed random bugs with "duplicating" the player or platforms during the fast respawn
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug caused by obj_bug in the jungle
    [*](FIX) Fixed ingame menu that could not appear on lower fps when pressing escape button
    [*](FIX) Fixed ingame statistics
    [*](FIX) Synchronized subtitles with actual voiceover
    [*](FIX) Switched XBOX360 controller button (X) for confirm to (A) button
    [*](FIX) Added font support for more languages
    [*](FIX) Fixed sound volume issues
    [*](FIX) Fixed crashing the game in the lava run and crazy avalanche levels
    [*](FIX) Fixed Cpt. Jetsen rescue mission
    [*](FIX) Fixed un-achievable achievements
    [*](FIX) Fixed a bunch of critical bugs, causing crashes on some machines   
[/list] 
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]Adding support for even more controllers
    [*]Option to play the game in "Adventure mode" with less dialogues
    [*]Adding more languages (Russian, Polish, German, Italian, French)
[/list]

Big thanks to Emilio J. Grao Benedí who is behind the SPANISH version of the game. He helped us with translation of the game - so, everyone who speaks SPANISH can enjoy the game even more!

In the meantime we are working hard to bring you another exciting news! Of course, releasing this update resolves many issues, but we are talking also about the future.

[h1]DLC: Testing Laboratory[/h1]
On the 30th of April, you will experience a new chapter from the story! DLC: Testing Laboratory tells the story back on the Earth. Test Lab is kind of a flashback chapter, or a prequel if you want. Our hero just signed up for the Endera's suicide mission, but he wants to be captain of the mission. What really happens and why he ended up as the coffee-guy? Try to uncover this secret!

This DLC will be available for all owners of Collector's Edition for free! If you don't want to miss this chapter, you have the option to upgrade your game to the Collector's Edition. Or you can buy this DLC separately.

[b]DLC: Testing Laboratory[/b] 
[i][b]Approx. game time:[/b] +1 hour of gameplay[/i]
[i][b]Release date:[/b] 30th April[/i]
[i][b]Price:[/b] Free (Collector's Edition) or 1,99 USD/€[/i]


[h1]Free story update: Secret of the Entity[/h1]
And even more exciting news! If you don't want to go deep into DLC stories, we are preparing a big content update for all players for free! With version 1.0.5 you will get access to experience "Secret of the Entity". More levels and more story incoming!

[b]UPDATE: Secret of the Entity[/b] 
[i][b]Approx. game time:[/b] 5+ hours of gameplay[/i]
[i][b]Release date:[/b] May 2015[/i]
[i][b]Price:[/b] Free for all users[/i]


On the other hand, we want to greatly apologize to all players with Windows XP, before this update Windows XP was functional, but we have updated our code to a new engine version which also means that Windows XP is no longer supported (in fact it has never been, but we want to be honest and say this).

Also, we want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hear how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio

notes.title: The completed version of Blackhole comes out on 27th February
notes.notes:
We hereby announce that the official date of the Blackhole game release is the [b]27th of February[/b].

So what can you look forward to after the activation of the game? We have prepared strong road map for bringing even more game content after the launch! These things will come in the following weeks, so, how’s it gonna be?

[b]Briefly after the game is released, certain things will be unlocked during the March:[/b]
[list]	[*]The Mac version 1.0, complete Blackhole story[/*]	[*]The Linux version 1.0, complete Blackhole story[/*][*]Correction of any possible errors[/*]	[*]Improved graphics wherever needed (if anywhere at all)[/*][/list]
[b]During the April 2015:[/b]
[list]	[*]Online mode, rankings, the opportunity to share your time from levels with the world[/*]	[*]Challenge Vault ([b]a new level every week![/b])[/*]	[*]A big free update: „Secret Of The Entity“, which adds the story after you finish the game (yep, there’s more!)[/*][/list]
[b]Things to finally come in May 2015:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]DLC: Testing Laboratory – [/b]only those who own the Collector’s Edition will get the DLC. [b]You can’t buy it separately.[/b][/*][/list]

It’s been almost one year since we’d announced that we’re working on Blackhole, and it’s been a crazy year. So many events, so much work, and everything leads to one specific day: either everything’s going to work out, or it all ends up ruined.

We hope you get the best possible experience in our universe. We can't wait to see your feedback :). See you on 27th...
